title: Prosecution: How did VP Duterte’s declared wealth rise by P33.35M?

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutors will trace the source of the P33.35-million increase in Vice President Sara Duterte’s declared net worth from 2021 to 2025, prosecution counsel and spokesperson Benjamin Tolosa Jr. said in a press conference at Tuesday’s impeachment trial proceedings. Then, he added, the prosecutors will find out whether the amount can be accounted for by legitimate income reflected in her tax records with the Bureau of Internal Revenue and other financial documents. An increase in wealth is not by itself improper, Tolosa stressed. But public officials must be able to show where it came from. READ: Unexplained wealth case […]...
